HAVE SEEN.meaning: 從過去到現在的經驗或剛完成的動作
HAVE SEEN.example: I have seen that new science documentary recently. It is fascinating.
HAVE SEEN.exampleZh: 主詞 I 搭配 have，且句尾有 recently（最近），需使用現在完成式 (have + V-p.p.)，表示從過去到現在的經驗或剛完成的動作。

HAS WORKED.meaning: 從過去一直持續到現在的狀態
HAS WORKED.example: Mr. Lin has worked in the marketing department for five years.
HAS WORKED.exampleZh: 句子中有 for five years（持續五年），表示從過去一直持續到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成式 has worked。

HAVE FINISHED.meaning: 常用於現在完成式的疑問句或否定句
HAVE FINISHED.example: Have / finished you ___ the final editing of the video yet?

HAS LAUNCHED.example: The tech firm has launched a new smartwatch that tracks your daily steps.

HAVE NOT RECEIVED.example: We have not received the official confirmation from the client yet, so please wait.
HAVE NOT RECEIVED.exampleZh: 句尾的 yet 提示現在完成式，表示「目前還沒有收到」，結構為 have not + V-p.p.，因此選 have not received。

PRESS.example: If you press the red button, the machine will shut down immediately.

ARE CLEANED.example: All the guest rooms in this hotel are cleaned perfectly every morning.

WAS STOLEN.example: My wallet was stolen while I was taking the bus to work.

WILL BE SOLVED.example: The technical problem will be solved by our IT team by tomorrow afternoon.
WILL BE SOLVED.exampleZh: 時間點為 by tomorrow afternoon（明天下午之前），表示未來的動作，且問題是「被」解決，故選未來被動語態 will be solved

IS SPOKEN.example: English is spoken in many different countries around the world.

TO SAVE ENERGY.meaning: 如果我們這麼做，辦公室將省下大量能源
TO SAVE ENERGY.example:
【短文】We have decided to turn off the lights at night. If we do this, the office will save a lot of energy.

TO SAVE ENERGY.exampleZh: 短文指出「If we do this, the office will save a lot of energy.」（如果我們這麼做，辦公室將省下大量能源）

IS USED.example: The new smartphone is used by millions of people already.
IS USED.exampleZh: 主詞 The new smartphone 為單數，且與動詞 use（使用）是被動關係。

HAS CREATED.meaning: 已經創造出一個好用的應用程式
HAS CREATED.example: Our tech team has created a useful application for language learning.

ARE STORED.example: All digital files are stored on a secure server to prevent any data loss.

HAS BEEN ATTACKED.example:

REMOTE.meaning: 許多公司現在允許『遠距

WILL SEND.example: 【時態】will 與時間副詞的搭配

ARE POSTED.example: Important company rules are posted on the information wall for everyone to see.

examples.zh: 這款當季水果塔比抹茶蛋糕甜點還要甜。

RECEIPT.exampleZh: 購物結帳後核對商品金額的明細紙條是「收據/發票」receipt。

HAS MANAGED.meaning: 從過去持續到現在的動作或經驗
HAS MANAGED.example: Since he joined the team, he has managed three different marketing tasks.
HAS MANAGED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：句首有 Since 加上過去式，主要子句需用現在完成式 (has/have + p.p.)，表示從過去持續到現在的動作或經驗。

HAVE FORGOTTEN.example: I have forgotten my password, so I cannot log into the system right now.
HAVE FORGOTTEN.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：忘記密碼是發生在過去但對「現在」造成影響（無法登入）的動作，應使用現在完成式。

DO NOT ARRIVE.example: You will miss your flight if you do not arrive at the gate on time.
DO NOT ARRIVE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：這是一般條件句（第一類條件句），主要子句用未來式 (will miss)，If 子句要用現在簡單式。

IS UPDATED.example: The daily schedule is updated by the manager every morning before work begins.
IS UPDATED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主詞 The daily schedule 是動作承受者（被更新），且由 every morning 可知是常態性動作，需用現在簡單式的被動語態 (is/are + p.p.)，故選 is updated。

ARE PRODUCED.example: These smart devices are produced in Taiwan for the global market.
ARE PRODUCED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主詞 devices（裝置）無法自己製造，必須「被製造」，因此要用被動語態 (are + produced)。

IDENTITY.meaning: 你需要有效的護照來確認你的身分
IDENTITY.example: You need a valid passport to confirm your identity at the airport desk.
IDENTITY.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：句意為「你需要有效的護照來確認你的身分」。

HAVE NOT INSTALLED.example: They have not installed the new software on all office computers yet.
HAVE NOT INSTALLED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：句尾有 yet，通常搭配現在完成式的否定句或疑問句，表示「到目前為止尚未...」。

DOES.example: A: What time does the new manager arrive at the company? B: She usually arrives at 8:45 every morning.
DOES.exampleZh: 主詞 the new manager 為第三人稱單數，一般動詞 arrive 的現在簡單式疑問句應使用助動詞 does。

WILL BE MARKED.example: The final exam papers will be marked by the teachers next week.
WILL BE MARKED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主詞 exam papers 是被批改的對象，且時間是 next week（下週），所以需要未來式的被動語態 (will be + p.p.)，故選 will be marked

IS SENT.example: A confirmation email is sent to your inbox immediately after you pay.
IS SENT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：email 無法自己發送，必須「被發送」，所以需用被動語態 (is + sent)。

SUGGESTS.example: The health expert suggests eating more vegetables to lower your blood pressure.
SUGGESTS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：健康專家「建議」多吃蔬菜以降低血壓。

HAVE RECEIVED.example: We have received a lot of positive feedback from our guests this month.
HAVE RECEIVED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：this month 指「這個月到目前為止」，常搭配現在完成式 (have/has + p.p.) 來表達目前為止的經驗或累積的結果。

WAS MADE.example: This beautiful wooden chair was made by a local artist in the 1990s.
WAS MADE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：椅子是「被製作」的，且時間是過去的 1990 年代，故應使用過去簡單式的被動語態 (was/were + p.p.)

WILL BE BROUGHT.example: Some extra chairs will be brought to the meeting room before the guests arrive.
WILL BE BROUGHT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主詞 chairs 是動作承受者，且由 before the guests arrive（在客人抵達前）可知動作發生在未來，需用未來被動語態 (will be + p.p.)

WILL EMAIL.example:
A: Have you sent the files? 
B: Not yet. If I finish editing them, I will email them to you right away.
WILL EMAIL.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：B 回答中的 If 子句用現在式 (finish)，表示未來的假設條件，主要子句應搭配未來式 (will + 原形動詞)，表示「我將會寄給你」

WAS DELIVERED.example:
A: Where is my package? 
B: It was delivered by the delivery company yesterday afternoon.
WAS DELIVERED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：包裹是被運送的（被動語態），且時間是 yesterday afternoon（過去時間），所以要用過去簡單被動語態 (was delivered)

HAVE PRINTED.meaning: 已經印好了且報告在桌上
HAVE PRINTED.example:
A: Is the report ready? 
B: Yes, I have printed it, and it is on your desk now.
HAVE PRINTED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：B 表示已經印好了且報告在桌上，強調過去動作對現在造成的結果，使用現在完成式 (have printed) 最合適。

WAS FLOODED.example:
A: Why is the road closed? 
B: It was flooded by the heavy rain last night.
WAS FLOODED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：道路是「被淹沒」的，時間是 last night，所以必須用過去簡單式的被動語態 (was flooded)

WILL ADD.example:
A: Can I still join the tour? 
B: Yes, if you pay the fee now, I will add your name to the list.
WILL ADD.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：這是一般條件句，If 子句用現在式 (pay)，表示只要現在付費，主要子句就會發生，所以主要子句用未來式 (will add)

FEE.example: The hotel charges an extra fee if you want to check out after 2:00 PM.
FEE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：飯店會收取額外的「費用 (fee)」。

HAS CANCELED.example: The manager has canceled the meeting because several key members were sick.
HAS CANCELED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：雖然 because 子句是過去式，但主要子句描述的「取消」這件事是已經發生且影響到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成式 (has canceled) 是合理的。

BE WASHED.example: All the dirty dishes must be washed before we close the kitchen tonight.
BE WASHED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：盤子必須「被洗」，助動詞 must 後面接原形動詞，因此被動語態的結構為 must + be + p.p.，故選 be washed

HAVE TRAVELED.example:
A: Have you ever visited Tokyo? 
B: Yes, I have traveled there twice for business trips.
HAVE TRAVELED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：回答「曾經去過幾次」是表達從過去到現在累積的經驗，應使用現在完成式 (have traveled)。

WILL PAY.example:
A: What happens if I lose my room key? 
B: If you lose it, you will pay a fine of fifty dollars.
WILL PAY.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用現在式 (lose)，表示未來可能發生的狀況，主要子句則用未來式表示結果 (will pay)

HAVE BEEN CHECKED.example:
A: Are the documents ready for signing? 
B: Yes, they have been checked by the legal team already.
HAVE BEEN CHECKED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文件是「被檢查」，且句尾有 already，表示動作已經完成，要用現在完成式的被動語態 (have been + p.p.)

COLLECTION.example: The museum has a wonderful collection of ancient Roman coins on the second floor.
COLLECTION.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：博物館在二樓有很棒的古羅馬硬幣「收藏 (collection)」。

MUST BE PROVIDED.example: If you want to access the fast internet, a password must be provided by the staff.
MUST BE PROVIDED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：密碼是「被提供」的對象，所以需要被動語態 (must be provided)。

IN THE SCHOOL HALL.example:
Community Event: We are hosting a bake sale this Saturday for the local library. Many cakes have been baked by our helpers. If it rains, the event will be moved to the school hall. 
Question: Where will the event be if the weather is bad?
IN THE SCHOOL HALL.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：短文最後一句說：如果下雨，活動將移至學校大廳 (moved to the school hall)。

A LIGHT JOG.example:
Health Tips: Stretching before running is no longer suggested by some experts. They believe a light jog is better. If you start with a slow run, your body will warm up naturally. 
Question: What is a good warm-up activity?
A LIGHT JOG.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文中提到專家認為輕鬆慢跑 (a light jog) 是更好的暖身方式，不再建議跑前拉筋。

HAS FIXED.example: The landlord has fixed the broken window in the living room.

WERE GIVEN.example: The keys were given to the new renters yesterday afternoon.
WERE GIVEN.exampleZh: 這題測試過去式的被動語態

CARTON.example: Please pack all your books into this wooden carton.

HAVE WATCHED.example: I have watched all the online videos for this week's lesson.

FAILS.meaning: 這題測試第一類條件句
FAILS.example: If the internet connection fails, you will lose your quiz answers.
FAILS.exampleZh: 這題測試第一類條件句。

WILL BE CALCULATED.example: The final grades will be calculated by the system automatically next Monday.
WILL BE CALCULATED.exampleZh: 這題測試未來式的被動語態

ASSIGNMENT.example: You must finish your assignment by tomorrow.
ASSIGNMENT.exampleZh: 你明天前必須完成你的作業。

examples.en: You must finish your assignment by tomorrow.
examples.zh: 你明天前必須完成你的作業。

examples.en: The teacher will give us a new assignment.
examples.zh: 老師將會給我們一項新作業。

WINS.meaning: 這題測試第一類條件句
WINS.example: If our team wins this match, they will go to the finals.
WINS.exampleZh: 這題測試第一類條件句。

WILL BE SHOWN.example: The baseball game will be shown on television tonight.
WILL BE SHOWN.exampleZh: 這題測試未來式的被動語態

REFEREE.example: The referee blew his whistle to stop the players.

HAS REPORTED.example: The local news channel has reported the election results already.

HITS.meaning: 這題測試第一類條件句
HITS.example: If the storm hits the city, the mayor will close the schools.
HITS.exampleZh: 這題測試第一類條件句。

WAS FILMED.example: The interview with the singer was filmed in the studio yesterday.
WAS FILMED.exampleZh: 這題測試過去被動語態

HEADLINE.example: Did you read the main headline on the front page today?

HAS EMAILED.meaning: 動作已經發生並對現在有影響
HAS EMAILED.example: The manager has emailed the meeting schedule to all staff.

UPLOAD.example: She is uploading the photos from our trip.

examples.en: She is uploading the photos from our trip.
examples.zh: 她正在上傳我們旅行的照片。

examples.en: I uploaded the report to the website yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天把報告上傳到網站了。

WILL BE DISCUSSED.example: The new security rules will be discussed at the meeting next Friday.
WILL BE DISCUSSED.exampleZh: 這題測試未來式的被動語態

FOLDER.example: Save the file in this folder.
FOLDER.exampleZh: 把檔案存在這個資料夾。

HAS CLEANED.meaning: 清潔公司已經完成打掃
HAS CLEANED.example:
A: Is the apartment ready for us? 
B: Yes, the cleaning company has cleaned all the rooms.

BREAK.meaning: 這題測試第一類條件句
BREAK.example:
A: What happens if I want to move out early? 
B: If you break the lease early, you will lose some money.
BREAK.exampleZh: 這題測試第一類條件句。

IS BEING VIEWED.example:
A: When can we see the new house? 
B: It is being viewed by another family right now, so we must wait.
IS BEING VIEWED.exampleZh: 這題測試現在進行式的被動語態。

HAVE NOT WRITTEN.example:
A: Have you finished the writing task? 
B: No, I have not written the essay yet, but I will do it tonight.

INSTALL.example: I need to install this software.

examples.en: They will install the new system tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他們明天會安裝新系統。

examples.en: We hired someone to install the air conditioner.
examples.zh: 我們請人來安裝冷氣機。

WILL BE SENT.meaning: 這題測試未來式的被動語態
WILL BE SENT.example:
A: How will I get my test results? 
B: They will be sent to your personal email account next week.
WILL BE SENT.exampleZh: 這題測試未來式的被動語態

HAS SHOWN.meaning: 從過去持續到現在的狀態
HAS SHOWN.example:
A: Who is leading the golf tournament? 
B: David is. He has shown amazing skills since the first round.

WERE LEFT.meaning: 今天早上，這裡指過去的時間
WERE LEFT.example:
A: Where are the new basketballs? 
B: They were left in the sports hall by the coach this morning.
WERE LEFT.exampleZh: 這題測試過去被動語態

HAVE BLOCKED.example:
A: Why is the road closed?

DROPS.meaning: 這題測試第一類條件句
DROPS.example:
A: Did you see the weather report? 
B: Yes, if the temperature drops, it will snow tomorrow.
DROPS.exampleZh: 這題測試第一類條件句。

WAS BROADCAST.example:
A: Did the mayor give a speech? 
B: Yes, his speech was broadcast on the radio an hour ago.
WAS BROADCAST.exampleZh: 這題測試過去被動語態

HAS GONE.example:
A: Where is the boss? 
B: She has gone to London for a business trip.

IS BEING CHECKED.example:
A: Is the sales report ready? 
B: Not yet. It is being checked by the manager right now.
IS BEING CHECKED.exampleZh: 這題測試現在進行被動語態。

FINISH OR CONCLUDE.example: The phrase "finish or conclude" is frequently used in practical English communication.
FINISH OR CONCLUDE.exampleZh: 「wrap up」是在實用英語溝通中經常運用的重要表達。

DEADLINE.example: We must submit the proposal before the deadline.

I HAVENT DECIDED YET.meaning: 如果你贏得獎學金，你會選擇哪一所大學？
I HAVENT DECIDED YET.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
I HAVENT DECIDED YET.exampleZh: 聽到「如果你贏得獎學金，你會選擇哪一所大學？」最適合回答「我還沒決定

WAS.example: The new software was installed on all office computers yesterday afternoon.
WAS.exampleZh: yesterday afternoon 是過去式，主詞 software 是不可數名詞，被動語態用 was installed。

examples.en: I agree with you.
examples.zh: 我同意你的看法。

examples.en: He will agree to the plan.
examples.zh: 他將會同意這個計畫。

SOLUTION.example: Our team has been trying to find a better solution to solve this complex engineering problem.
SOLUTION.exampleZh: solution 意為「解決方案」，與後面的 solve this problem 呼應。

INVITATIONS TO PRIVATE EVENTS.meaning: 意即能受邀參加私人展館活動
INVITATIONS TO PRIVATE EVENTS.example:
【短文】The gallery has hosted several modern art exhibitions this year. If you purchase an annual membership, you will be invited to all private gallery events. 
Question: What is a benefit of the annual membership?
INVITATIONS TO PRIVATE EVENTS.exampleZh: 文中提到「If you purchase an annual membership, you will be invited to all private gallery events」，意即能受邀參加私人展館活動

HAVE RECENTLY BEEN INTRODUCED.example: The new environmental laws have recently been introduced by the government to reduce carbon emissions across the country.
HAVE RECENTLY BEEN INTRODUCED.exampleZh: 主詞 laws (法律) 是被引入的，需要被動語態，且搭配 recently 通常用現在完成式，故選 have been introduced 的現在完成被動式。

GO AHEAD WITH.example: The CEO decided to go ahead with the new strategy instead of sticking to the old business model.
GO AHEAD WITH.exampleZh: go ahead with 意為「推進、開始執行」。

WILL HAVE BEEN SENT.example: The financial report will have been sent to the investors by the time they arrive for the annual meeting tomorrow.
WILL HAVE BEEN SENT.exampleZh: by the time 加上未來的時間點，常搭配未來完成式

VEHICLE.example: You cannot park your vehicle here.

examples.zh: 你不能把你的車輛停在這裡。

examples.en: The police will check every vehicle on the road.
examples.zh: 警察將會檢查路上的每一輛車。

RECOMMEND.example: I will recommend this book to my friends.

examples.en: I will recommend this book to my friends.

examples.en: Can you recommend a good hotel for me?
examples.zh: 你能推薦我一家好的飯店嗎？

EXCELLENT.example: The food at the party was excellent.

examples.en: The food at the party was excellent.
examples.zh: 派對上的食物非常棒。

examples.en: They are doing an excellent job on this task.
examples.zh: 他們在這項任務上表現得極好。

MONITOR HEALTH DATA.example:
【短文】A smart ring was introduced by a tech company last month. It can track your heart rate and sleep patterns. 
Question: What can the smart ring do?
MONITOR HEALTH DATA.exampleZh: 短文中提到它能「track your heart rate and sleep patterns (追蹤心率與睡眠模式)」，這些皆屬於健康數據 (health data)，故選 (C)

THEY ARE PORTABLE.example:
【短文】Traditional books are still loved by many. However, digital reading has become more common because tablets are easy to carry. 
Question: Why is reading on tablets common?
THEY ARE PORTABLE.exampleZh: 短文提到平板閱讀變得普遍是因為「tablets are easy to carry (容易攜帶)」，portable 就是易於攜帶之意，故選 (D)

HAVING MORE FAMILY TIME.meaning: 如果不通勤，我們會有更多時間陪家人
HAVING MORE FAMILY TIME.example:
【短文】Remote work has changed our daily routines. If we do not commute, we will have more time to spend with our family. 
Question: What is an advantage of not commuting?
HAVING MORE FAMILY TIME.exampleZh: 短文提到「If we do not commute, we will have more time to spend with our family (如果不通勤，我們會有更多時間陪家人)」，故選 (D)

TO ENCOURAGE COMMUNICATION.example:
【短文】The office layout was redesigned by a famous studio. They added more open spaces so people can talk to each other easily. 
Question: Why did they add open spaces?
TO ENCOURAGE COMMUNICATION.exampleZh: 短文說明增加開放空間是為了「so people can talk to each other easily (讓人們容易交談)」，即鼓勵溝通 (encourage communication)，選 (A)

ASSIST THE DESIGNERS.meaning: 若提早完成，請協助設計團隊
ASSIST THE DESIGNERS.example:
【短文】Your primary task this week is to organize the customer files. If you finish early, please help the design team. 
Question: What should the person do if they complete their work early?
ASSIST THE DESIGNERS.exampleZh: 文中指示「If you finish early, please help the design team (若提早完成，請協助設計團隊)」，Assist the designers 意思與此相符，選 (B)

TO ASSIST WITH DIGESTION.example:
【短文】Green tea is known for its health benefits. It is consumed by millions of people in Asia to help digestion. 
Question: Why do many people drink green tea?
TO ASSIST WITH DIGESTION.exampleZh: 文中提到「consumed ... to help digestion (飲用以幫助消化)」，assist with digestion 為同義替換，選 (C)

DISAPPOINTED.example: We were very disappointed because the outdoor performance was canceled.
DISAPPOINTED.exampleZh: 因為戶外演出被取消，我們當時感到非常失望。

examples.en: The manager is feeling disappointed about the weak quarterly sales figures.
examples.zh: 經理目前對疲弱的季度銷售業績感到相當失望。

examples.en: He looked more disappointed than his team members after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，他看起來比隊友們更加沮喪失落。

PERFORMANCE.example: Her performance this year was excellent.

examples.en: I must apologize to him.
examples.zh: 我必須向他道歉。

examples.en: She should apologize for being late.
examples.zh: 她應該為遲到而道歉。

FACILITY.example: The new facility opens in May.

HASNT BOUGHT.example: He hasn't bought any new clothes since he started his minimalist lifestyle last year.
HASNT BOUGHT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式的否定型態

DONT REDUCE.meaning: 如果我們不減少使用塑膠瓶
DONT REDUCE.example: The ocean will become more polluted if we don't reduce the use of plastic bottles.
DONT REDUCE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句

BE FINISHED.example: All the final essays must be finished by Friday evening, or the teacher will not grade them.
BE FINISHED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗助動詞的被動語態

CONSERVATION.meaning: 保護自然資源而避免浪費或破壞
CONSERVATION.example: Conservation requires more than setting targets.
CONSERVATION.exampleZh: 資源保護不只是設定目標。

senses.meaning: 保護自然資源而避免浪費或破壞

examples.en: Conservation requires more than setting targets.
examples.zh: 資源保護不只是設定目標。

examples.en: The garden supports local conservation efforts.
examples.zh: 花園支持當地的自然保育工作。

EXPLORE.example: We are going to explore the city tomorrow.
EXPLORE.exampleZh: 我們明天打算去探索這座城市。

examples.en: We are going to explore the city tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天打算去探索這座城市。

examples.en: You should explore the local markets during your trip.
examples.zh: 你在旅行時應該去逛逛當地的市場。

JOURNEY.example: Our journey to the countryside was longer than I thought.
JOURNEY.exampleZh: 我們到鄉下的旅程比我想像的還要長。

examples.en: Our journey to the countryside was longer than I thought.
examples.zh: 我們到鄉下的旅程比我想像的還要長。

examples.en: We are planning a new journey for next summer.
examples.zh: 我們正在為明年夏天規劃一趟新旅程。

IS PLANNED.example: The new marketing STRATEGY is planned carefully by the head of the team.
IS PLANNED.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「被計畫的」的實際運用。

RESERVATION.meaning: 預先訂妥座位或房間的安排
RESERVATION.example: Our reservation is for six thirty.

senses.meaning: 預先訂妥座位或房間的安排

examples.en: Our reservation is for six thirty.
examples.zh: 我們預訂六點半。

examples.en: Please give the name on the reservation.
examples.zh: 請告知訂位姓名。

HAS NOT BEEN.example: We should focus on the usage of has not been in modern English.
HAS NOT BEEN.exampleZh: 在現代英文語境中應充分掌握「單數」的核心用法。

TO AVOID CONFUSING CUSTOMERS.example: The store updated its return policy labels to avoid confusing customers.
TO AVOID CONFUSING CUSTOMERS.exampleZh: 這家商店更新了退換貨政策標籤，以避免使顧客困惑。

MODIFIED.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「已經被修改」。

FURNITURE.example: We bought modern wooden furniture for our new living room yesterday.
FURNITURE.exampleZh: 我們昨天為新客廳買了現代風的木製家具。

examples.en: The delivery workers are moving heavy furniture up the stairs.
examples.zh: 搬運工人正在把沉重的家具搬上樓梯。

examples.en: This sofa was the most expensive piece of furniture in the showroom.
examples.zh: 這張沙發是展示中心裡最昂貴的一件家具。

IS CONFIRMED.example: If the online payment is confirmed, the system will automatically generate an electronic receipt for you.
IS CONFIRMED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：這是稍微進階的融合題。

HAS BEEN TRANSFORMED.example: Over the past few months, the old library has been transformed into a modern community center.
HAS BEEN TRANSFORMED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：時間副詞 Over the past few months 需搭配現在完成式；而圖書館是「被改造」的，因此要用現在完成式的被動語態 (has been + p.p.)

DO NOT RESOLVE.example: If they do not resolve the issue immediately, the problem will only get worse.
DO NOT RESOLVE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：第一類條件句中，主要子句用未來式 (will get)，If 子句需用現在式。

HAS IMPROVED.meaning: 從過去持續到現在的進步
HAS IMPROVED.example: Since the new manager arrived, communication between the teams has improved significantly.
HAS IMPROVED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：Since 子句用過去式，主要子句須搭配現在完成式 (has/have + p.p.)，表示從過去持續到現在的進步。

BE CHECKED.example: If you are traveling abroad, your passport must be checked before you book the flight.
BE CHECKED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：護照是「被檢查」的對象，助動詞 must 後面接原形，因此被動語態為 must + be + p.p. (be checked)

HAS REACHED.example: The company has reached its target for this quarter, so everyone will receive a bonus.
HAS REACHED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：公司「已經達到」本季的目標，結果是大家會拿到獎金。

WILL NOT BE SENT.example:
A: Have you reviewed the document? 
B: Yes, but I found some errors. If they are not corrected, the document will not be sent tonight.
WILL NOT BE SENT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用現在式的被動語態 (are not corrected)，主要子句表示未來的結果，須用未來式的被動語態，文件「將不會被寄出」(will not be sent)

PROTECT.example: We have to protect the environment.

examples.en: We have to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 我們必須保護環境。

examples.en: A good password will protect your online account.
examples.zh: 好的密碼將會保護你的線上帳號。

ARE INFLUENCED.example: The latest fashion trends are influenced by social media more than ever before.
ARE INFLUENCED.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：主詞 trends（趨勢）是複數，且是「被影響」的對象，所以要用現在式複數的被動語態 (are influenced)。

PAY ATTENTION TO SPELLING.meaning: 如果想要更高的分數，必須更仔細檢查拼字
PAY ATTENTION TO SPELLING.example:
Message from Tutor: I have checked your recent assignments. Your writing has gotten much better lately. However, if you want a higher grade, you must check your spelling more carefully. 
Question: What does the tutor advise the student to do?
PAY ATTENTION TO SPELLING.exampleZh: 導師在訊息中提到「if you want a higher grade, you must check your spelling more carefully（如果想要更高的分數，必須更仔細檢查拼字）」，因此選 D。

THE DOOR LOCKS COMPLETELY.meaning: 如果輸入錯誤密碼三次，門將會完全鎖死
THE DOOR LOCKS COMPLETELY.example:
Internal Email: We have updated the office security system. A new access code has been sent to your phone. If you enter the wrong code three times, the door will be locked completely. 
Question: What happens after three wrong attempts?
THE DOOR LOCKS COMPLETELY.exampleZh: 信件中寫道「If you enter the wrong code three times, the door will be locked completely.（如果輸入錯誤密碼三次，門將會完全鎖死）」。

THE MARKETING TEAM.meaning: 今年的年度員工派對將由行銷團隊策劃
THE MARKETING TEAM.example:
Office Memo: The annual staff party will be planned by the marketing team this year. It will be held at a seaside restaurant. If you plan to go to the party, please answer this email before Wednesday. 
Question: Who is planning the staff party?
THE MARKETING TEAM.exampleZh: 備忘錄第一句為「The annual staff party will be planned by the marketing team this year.（今年的年度員工派對將由行銷團隊策劃）」，因此選 B。

WITH YELLOW SIGNS.meaning: 比賽路線已經用黃色標誌標示
WITH YELLOW SIGNS.example:
Running Club: Welcome to the city marathon! The race path has been marked with yellow signs. If you feel sick during the run, medical tents can be found every five kilometers. 
Question: How is the race path marked?
WITH YELLOW SIGNS.exampleZh: 文中的第二句是「The race path has been marked with yellow signs.（比賽路線已經用黃色標誌標示）」，故選 B。

CLOSE THE MAJOR HIGHWAYS.meaning: 今晚主要高速公路可能被警方封閉
CLOSE THE MAJOR HIGHWAYS.example:
Weather Alert: Heavy snow has been predicted for the northern region. Major highways might be closed by the police tonight. If you must travel, drive slowly and carry warm clothes. 
Question: What might the police do tonight?
CLOSE THE MAJOR HIGHWAYS.exampleZh: 警報中提到「Major highways might be closed by the police tonight.（今晚主要高速公路可能被警方封閉）」，因此選 C。

PROPOSAL.exampleZh: 董事會接受了我們的提案。

SEE.example: I can see the mountains from my room.

ROOM.example: My room is on the second floor.

CLEAN.example: I clean my room on Saturday.

READ.example: Read the contract carefully before signing.
READ.exampleZh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀合約。

BUY.example: I bought two tickets for the morning flight.

DELAYED.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「延遲；延誤」。

RAIN.example: Take an umbrella in the rain.

TEST.example: We have an English test today.

PASS.example: She passed the certification exam on her first attempt.
PASS.exampleZh: 她初次嘗試就通過了證照考試。

ACCEPT.example: I will accept the job offer tomorrow.
ACCEPT.exampleZh: 我明天將會接受這份工作邀約。

REACH.example: You can reach me by email during office hours.
REACH.exampleZh: 上班時間您可以透過電子郵件與我聯繫。

COST.example: What is the cost of the ticket?

TRAVEL.example: I love to travel by train.

GO.example: They go to work by bus.

THERE.example: there are two birds in the park.
THERE.exampleZh: There are 表示「有」，後面接複數名詞 two birds，所以選 There。

WEEK.example: I work five days a week.

BROKEN.example: He will fix the broken window tomorrow.
BROKEN.exampleZh: 他明天會修理破掉的窗戶。

NEED.example: I need a pen to write.

ALREADY.example: I have already finished my homework.
ALREADY.exampleZh: already 放在 have 與過去分詞之間，表示「已經」。

CHEAP.example: This hotel is cheap and clean.

LIKE.meaning: 點餐最常用的禮貌說法
LIKE.example: I'd like a cup of coffee, please.
LIKE.exampleZh: I'd like + 名詞，是點餐最常用的禮貌說法。

BRING.example: Please bring your laptop to the meeting.
BRING.exampleZh: 開會時請攜帶您的筆記型電腦。

PAID.example: A: "Independent musicians hardly make a living these days." B: "True. If streaming services paid a fairer percentage of their revenue, these artists wouldn't struggle so much."

CARD.exampleZh: 我可以用信用卡付錢嗎？

GRADE.example: She got a good grade in math.

CLASS.example: I have an English class this morning.

STUDENT.exampleZh: 每個學生都有一本筆記本。

WAIT.example: Please wait in line for inspection.

IMPORTANT.example: Water is important for our health.

SUBWAY.example: I take the subway to work.

MUSEUM.example: The museum is free on Sundays.

FAMOUS.exampleZh: 這家烘焙坊在 2022 年贏得國際大賽後一舉成名。

ARCHITECT.example: The talented architect designed this modern library three years ago.
ARCHITECT.exampleZh: 那位有才華的建築師三年前設計了這座現代圖書館。

BUILT.example: built on an assumption neither side had examined, the agreement proved fragile.

BUILD.example: They built a brand new facility outside the city.

GUEST.example: We are expecting some guests tonight.
GUEST.exampleZh: 我們今晚預計會有客人來。

WALLET.example: I lost my wallet on the bus.

BUS.example: I go to work by bus.

COUNTRY.exampleZh: 台灣是一個美麗的國家。

AROUND.example: A: May I try on this coat? B: Yes, of course. The fitting room is around the corner over there.

SPEAKS.example: My supervisor speaks two languages: English and Japanese.

SPEAKING.example: Many adults practice speaking foreign languages by conversing with native speakers online.

STORE.example: I go to the store to buy milk.

COMPANY.example: She works for a big company.

MADE.example: It is high time we made a decision.

PHONE.example: My phone is on the desk.

SUBURB.example: They bought a house in the suburbs.

CENTER.example: The office is in the city center.

TOURIST.example: The museum is full of tourists.

ART.example: I like to look at art.

FEVER.example: She had a high fever last night.

PLASTIC.example: We will stop using plastic bags.
PLASTIC.exampleZh: 我們將會停止使用塑膠袋。

BECOME.exampleZh: 他成為了一名成功的經理。

CAR.example: I wash my car on Sunday.

COME.example: Please come in and sit down.

TWO.meaning: 數字 2 的英文是什麼？
TWO.example: The phrase "two" is frequently used in practical English communication.
TWO.exampleZh: 「two」是在實用英語溝通中經常運用的重要表達。

OPEN.example: The store will open at nine tomorrow morning.
OPEN.exampleZh: 店家明天早上九點開始營業。

ASK.example: A: Do you know the answer to Question 5? B: No, I don't. Let's ask the teacher for help.
ASK.exampleZh: 祈使句提議句型「Let's」後面必須接動詞原形，故選 ask。

COMPUTER.example: I use a computer at work.

FIND.example: I found a great restaurant near the hotel.

ATTACH.example: I attached the file to the email.

LET.example: Let me check the schedule first.

SENT.meaning: 描述已發生的錯誤動作
SENT.example: She sent the email to the wrong person by mistake.

VOUCHER.example: You will receive a travel voucher as compensation for the delay.

PILOT.example: He is the most experienced pilot in the company.

RETURN.example: I want to return this shirt.

EATING.example: She couldn't resist eating a piece of chocolate cake after a long day at work.

DIET.example: You should eat a healthy diet.

SLEEP.example: I sleep eight hours a night.

BETTER.example: After taking the pills and getting some sleep, she feels much better today.

MANAGE.example: He managed to catch the bus which was delayed.
MANAGE.exampleZh: 他設法趕上了那班誤點的公車。

MEMBERSHIP.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「會費、會員費」。

VITAMIN.example: You should take a vitamin daily.
VITAMIN.exampleZh: 你應該每天吃一顆維他命。

PUT.example: Please put your luggage on the rack.
PUT.exampleZh: 請將您的行李放在架子上。

COUNTER.example: Pick up your drink at the counter.

STUDIO.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「工作室、練習室」。

CONCERT.example: Are you going to the pop concert?
CONCERT.exampleZh: 你要去那場流行音樂演唱會嗎？

STAGE.meaning: 演員走到舞台上並開始唱歌
STAGE.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「演員走到舞台上並開始唱歌」。

INVITE.example: She invited me to her party.
INVITE.exampleZh: 她邀請我參加她的派對。

WALK.example: It is a five-minute walk from here.
WALK.exampleZh: 從這裡走過去只要五分鐘。

RIVER.example: You have to pay to get on the ferry to get across the river.
RIVER.exampleZh: river 是「河流」，渡輪 (ferry) 是用來渡河的交通工具。

CASTLE.exampleZh: 我們參觀了一座古老的城堡。

COMFORTABLE.example: We stayed in a comfortable hotel during our holiday in Hualien.
COMFORTABLE.exampleZh: 我們在花蓮度假期間住了一家舒適的飯店。

HELMET.example: You must wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle to protect your head.
HELMET.exampleZh: helmet 是「安全帽」，騎機車保護頭部必須戴安全帽。

WRITE.example: She wrote a detailed summary of the event.
WRITE.exampleZh: 她寫了一份詳盡的活動摘要。

WIN.example: The team won first prize in the competition.
WIN.exampleZh: 該團隊在競賽中贏得了首獎。

HISTORICAL.example: I want to visit the historical museum.
HISTORICAL.exampleZh: 我想去參觀那間歷史博物館。

REDUCED.example: The valley lay below us, its cottages reduced to small pale marks.
REDUCED.exampleZh: 獨立結構 cottages reduced to...，在遠視中被縮成小點。

FISH.example: The fish at this market is fresh.

BRILLIANT.example: 「她是班上最brilliant的學生；她考試總是拿滿分」空格中應填入：
BRILLIANT.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「【詞彙】brilliant」的實際運用。

HIGHWAY.example: We are going to drive on the highway.
HIGHWAY.exampleZh: 我們將要開在高速公路上。

WAITER.exampleZh: 服務生送來了我們的飲料。

MENU.example: Could we have the menu, please?

SUITCASE.example: 「為了這趟旅行，他把衣服放進suitcase裡」空格中應填入：
SUITCASE.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「了這趟旅行」的實際運用。

DEMONSTRATE.example: The flaws must have been demonstrated by the QA team last week.
DEMONSTRATE.exampleZh: 這些缺陷上週一定已經被品保團隊證明過了。

KITCHEN.example: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.

TRAINING.exampleZh: 新進員工必須參加培訓。

SIT.example: Please sit in the waiting area.

DEGREE.example: He has a degree in economics.

POCKET.example: I have some money in my pocket.

EXPAND.example: They plan to expand into Asia.

COTTON.example: This shirt is made of cotton.

ADVICE.example: Your advice is more useful than his.
ADVICE.exampleZh: 你的建議比他的更有用。

MOTIVATED.example: She told me that the team had felt very motivated after the CEO's speech.
MOTIVATED.exampleZh: 她告訴我，在執行長發表演說後，團隊感到非常有動力。

BLANKET.example: It's cold. I need a blanket.

STRICTLY.example: The use of artificial food coloring is strictly prohibited in organic products.
STRICTLY.exampleZh: 句意為「有機產品中嚴格禁止使用人工食用色素」。

TOWEL.example: Can I have a clean towel?
TOWEL.exampleZh: 可以給我一條乾淨的毛巾嗎？

SHOULDER.example: He tapped me on the shoulder.

KEYBOARD.example: This keyboard is more expensive than that one.
KEYBOARD.exampleZh: 這個鍵盤比那個還要貴。

SOFA.example: We bought a new sofa for the living room because the old one was uncomfortable.
SOFA.exampleZh: sofa 是沙發，與「不舒服 (uncomfortable)」及「客廳 (living room)」的情境最搭。

ADDRESS.example: The manager held a meeting to address the customer's complaints.
ADDRESS.exampleZh: 經理召開會議以處理顧客的投訴。

THERAPY.example: Doctors often prescribe physical therapy to help patients recover their mobility after an accident.

RUMOR.example: There is a rumor that the CEO is leaving.
RUMOR.exampleZh: 有謠言說執行長即將離職。

INGREDIENTS.example: Consumers should carefully read the list of ingredients to avoid allergic reactions.
INGREDIENTS.exampleZh: 句意為「消費者應仔細閱讀成分表以避免過敏反應」。

REMAIN.example: The office will remain closed on national holidays.
REMAIN.exampleZh: 國定假日辦公室將保持關閉。

PROBABLY.example: We are probably going to visit Japan next month.
PROBABLY.exampleZh: 我們下個月可能會去日本旅遊。

HEATER.example: I turned on the heater because my bedroom was freezing.
HEATER.exampleZh: heater 是「暖氣機」，房間極冷 (freezing) 時需要開暖氣。

CLUB.example: To join the tennis club, you need to sign your name on this paper.
CLUB.exampleZh: club 是「社團、俱樂部」，加入網球社需要簽名。

VALIDATE.example: We need to validate the data before reporting it.
VALIDATE.exampleZh: 在報告之前，我們需要驗證這些數據。

CAMPING.example: Camping is cheaper than staying in a hotel.

SERVE.example: Breakfast is served from seven to ten.
SERVE.exampleZh: 早餐於七點至十點供應。

CORNER.example: The bank is on the corner.

GALLERY.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「畫廊、展覽館」。

DISPLAY.example: The new phones are on display.

MUG.meaning: 對某人的動機誠信等提出質疑
MUG.exampleZh: 對某人的動機誠信等提出質疑。

RESIDENTS.example: A: Who are the people gathering downstairs? B: They are the residents of this building having a meeting.

SUBMITTED.example: The report must be submitted to the manager by Friday.
SUBMITTED.exampleZh: must be + p.p. 被動語態：報告「被」提交。

SET.example: We need to set a date for the launch.
SET.exampleZh: 我們需要訂定發布日期。

PLATE.example: Please pass me that clean plate.

SPEAK.example: He speaks fluent English and Japanese.
SPEAK.exampleZh: 他能說流利的英文與日文。

STAND.example: Passengers should stand behind the yellow line.

CHEF.example: The head chef prepared a special dinner for the guests last night.
CHEF.exampleZh: 主廚昨晚為客人準備了特別的晚餐。

PERSON.example: He is a very nice person.

ASSIGN.example: The manager will assign specific duties to each team member.
ASSIGN.exampleZh: 經理將會分配特定的職責給每位團隊成員。

BELONGINGS.example: Make sure you have all your personal belongings.
BELONGINGS.exampleZh: 請確保您帶齊了所有個人隨身物品。

POOL.example: The hotel has a large swimming pool for guests to use.

TEMPORARY.example: This is only a temporary solution.
TEMPORARY.exampleZh: 這只是暫時的解決方法。

MANUAL.example: Reading the manual is necessary before using the machine.
MANUAL.exampleZh: 在使用機器之前閱讀手冊是必要的。

SATURDAY.example:
【短文】Student Club Fair:
Come and see over 50 different clubs! The fair will be held in the main square from Wednesday to Friday. Registration for new members opens on Saturday.
Q: When can students officially join a club?
SATURDAY.exampleZh: 展覽是週三到週五，但新成員的註冊(Registration)是在週六(Saturday)開放，所以週六才能正式加入

CAKE.example: We have cake on her birthday.

DOWNTOWN.exampleZh: 我們在台北市中心工作。

BELIEVE.example: I believe we can meet the deadline.
BELIEVE.exampleZh: 我相信我們能趕上截止日期。

DEPARTS.meaning: 火車時刻表屬於固定行程
DEPARTS.example: The express train departs from PLATFORM 3 at 9:15 AM.
DEPARTS.exampleZh: 火車時刻表屬於固定行程，即使是未來發生的事，也常用現在簡單式表示，因此選 departs。

BOARD.example: 「你有看到board上的通知嗎？」空格中應填入：
BOARD.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「【詞彙】board」的實際運用。

MATCH.example: Did you watch the tennis match?
MATCH.exampleZh: 你有看那場網球比賽嗎？

GAME.example: Do you want to play a game?

PAYING.example: Active listening requires paying close attention to the speaker's body language.
PAYING.exampleZh: require 當作「需要」解釋時，若主詞是事物（如 Active listening），後面通常接動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞，故選 D. paying。

WATCHED.example: I watched a movie last night.
WATCHED.exampleZh: last night 表示過去，規則動詞加 -ed：watch → watched。

CALCULATE.example: If I had calculated the figures incorrectly, the budget proposal wouldn't have been approved.
CALCULATE.exampleZh: 如果我算錯了數字，預算案就不會被通過了。

LEAD.example: Her innovative ideas led to great success.
LEAD.exampleZh: 她的創新理念帶來了巨大的成功。

SUPPLY.exampleZh: 我們需要更多辦公用品。

HEATING.example: Turn on the heating during winter.

DEGREES.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「度數（溫度）」。

RENEW.example: Please renew your contract before May.

MUTE.example: Please unmute your microphone to speak.

WRAP.example: Let us wrap up today's discussion.

PRESCRIPTION.example: You need a prescription for antibiotics.

EVALUATE.example: We need to evaluate the results.

UNDER.example: The cat is sleeping under the sofa.
UNDER.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「在...下方」的實際運用。

EMISSIONS.meaning: 排放到空氣中的氣體或物質
EMISSIONS.example: The plan sets a target for reducing emissions.
EMISSIONS.exampleZh: 計畫設定減少排放的目標。

RENEWABLE.meaning: 能自然補充而可再生的
RENEWABLE.example: The site uses renewable energy for heating.
RENEWABLE.exampleZh: 場地使用再生能源供暖。

GENERATE.example: If the campaign had generated more leads, we would have met the target.
GENERATE.exampleZh: 如果這場活動帶來了更多潛在客戶，我們就會達到目標了。

ACTIVE.example: He is always active in the morning.

MONITOR.example: My company bought a curved computer monitor for my desk last week.
MONITOR.exampleZh: 我們公司上週為我的辦公桌買了一台曲面電腦螢幕。

GREEN.example: The trees are green in spring.

CONSUMED.example: If people consumed more vegetables and less processed food, their immune systems would be stronger.
CONSUMED.exampleZh: 【解析】主要子句有 would be，判斷為與現在事實相反的第二類條件句，因此 If 從句中的動詞需使用過去式 (consumed)，故選 (A)。

DOING.example:
A: How do you handle stress? 
B: I practice doing deep breathing exercises every morning.

CONSTRUCT.example: She said they had constructed the new facility in just six months.
CONSTRUCT.exampleZh: 她說他們僅花了六個月就建構好新設施。

COMMITTEE.example: The committee will decide next week.

ALTHOUGH.example: although it was raining, we went out.
ALTHOUGH.exampleZh: although 表示「雖然」，前後語意相反。

IMPLEMENT.example: We will implement the plan in June.
IMPLEMENT.exampleZh: 我們將在六月實施計畫。

CAREER.example: She will start a new career in marketing.
CAREER.exampleZh: 她將會在行銷領域開始新的職業生涯。

ENCOURAGED.example: encouraged by the results, the team decided to expand the project.

CUP.example: I want a cup of coffee.

GROCERY.exampleZh: 下班後我必須買些雜貨。

DEDUCT.example: Taxes are deducted from your salary.

ESTIMATE.example: Can you give me an estimate?
ESTIMATE.exampleZh: 你可以給我一個估價嗎？

FALL.example: Prices are expected to fall next month.
FALL.exampleZh: 預計價格下個月會下跌。

SCHEDULES.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「行程表；時間表」。

BARRIERS.example: Due to the rising sea levels, the government must build stronger physical barriers to protect the low-lying coastal cities from regular flooding.
BARRIERS.exampleZh: 正確答案是 B (障礙物 / 屏障)。

CALENDAR.example: I marked our project deadline on the calendar yesterday.
CALENDAR.exampleZh: 我昨天在行事曆上記下了我們專案的截止日。

PREDICT.example: She stated that they had predicted the market crash months in advance.
PREDICT.exampleZh: 她表示他們早在幾個月前就已預測到市場崩盤。

HEAVILY.example: Climate Report: The continuous desertification of arable land forces rural communities to flee. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
HEAVILY.exampleZh: 正確答案是 C (嚴重地 / 高度地)。

EXCITING.example: We watched an exciting baseball game at the stadium last night.
EXCITING.exampleZh: 我們昨晚在體育場看了一場令人興奮的棒球賽。

ACCIDENT.example: He had a car accident yesterday.

DRESS.exampleZh: 她穿著一件紅色的洋裝。

COUNTRYSIDE.example: The countryside is quieter than the city.

CASHIER.example: The cashier gave me the wrong change.
CASHIER.exampleZh: 收銀員找錯零錢給我了。

LL.meaning: 可能犯錯而非絕對可靠的性質
LL.exampleZh: 可能犯錯而非絕對可靠的性質。

PRINTER.example: The printer is out of paper.

FORTY.example: He drives for forty minutes to work.
FORTY.exampleZh: 他開車四十分鐘去上班。

SIGHT.example: My father wears glasses to improve his sight.

ELEVATOR.example: Take the elevator to the tenth floor.

ATMOSPHERE.example: They were enjoying the relaxing atmosphere when it started to rain.
ATMOSPHERE.exampleZh: 當開始下雨時，他們正在享受放鬆的氣氛。

MODIFY.example: The company decided to modify their marketing campaign to target younger customers.

VOLUME.example: Can you turn down the volume?

UNDERGROUND.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「這題考單字」。

PRESENT.example: Thank you for the Christmas present.

RELAXING.example: We are going to have a relaxing weekend.

TRANSFORM.example: The small fishing village has managed to transform itself into a popular resort destination.

STAR.example: Look at the stars in the sky.

BONUS.example: The company gave everyone a bonus for working hard this year.
BONUS.exampleZh: bonus 是「獎金、紅利」，符合努力工作 (working hard) 的情境。

RECOGNIZE.example: I didn't recognize you in that hat.
RECOGNIZE.exampleZh: 你戴那頂帽子我都認不出你來了。

PROHIBIT.example: The sign indicated that smoking had been strictly prohibited.
PROHIBIT.exampleZh: 標誌顯示嚴格禁止吸菸。

DRINKS.exampleZh: 現在簡單式，第三人稱單數（he）動詞加 -s：drink → drinks。

ATTEMPT.example: He will attempt to resolve the issue tomorrow.
ATTEMPT.exampleZh: 他明天將嘗試解決這個問題。

MEMO.example: Please read the memo from HR.

PATH.example: We missed the bus, so we had to walk along the dark path to get home.
PATH.exampleZh: path 是「小徑、路徑」，走在黑漆漆的路上回家符合語意。

YELLOW.exampleZh: 我搭乘一輛黃色計程車。

ALERT.example: The new wearable device can continuously monitor your heart rate and instantly alert you if it detects any dangerous irregular beats.
ALERT.exampleZh: 正確答案是 A (警示 / 發出警報)。
